class Book::AccessImport
  Result = Struct.new(:accesses, :duplicate_index)

  def initialize(book, grants)
    @book, @grants = book, grants
  end

  def import
    accesses = []
    duplicate_index = nil

    Access.transaction do
      @grants.each_with_index do |grant, index|
        access = @book.accesses.create!(user_id: grant[:user_id], level: grant[:level])
        Book::AccessNotificationJob.perform_later(access)
        accesses << access
      rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
        duplicate_index = index
        raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
      end
    end

    duplicate_index ? Result.new([], duplicate_index) : Result.new(accesses, nil)
  end
end

Because `Access.transaction` didn't use `requires_new: true`, it *joined* the outer transaction! Thankfully, our fix (validating before inserting and using `requires_new: true` on the `Access.transaction`) eliminates the issue. Now, even if we detect a duplicate or an invalid input, we don't even *attempt* the write, so no data is written! And if we use `Access.transaction(requires_new: true)`:

class Book::AccessImport
  Result = Struct.new(:accesses, :duplicate_index)

  def initialize(book, grants)
    @book, @grants = book, grants
  end

  def import
    records = build_records
    return Result.new([], nil) if records.empty?

    accesses = []
    duplicate_index = nil
    record_not_unique = false

    Access.transaction(requires_new: true) do
      preload_users(records)
      seen_user_ids = existing_user_ids_for(records)

      records.each_with_index do |record, index|
        record.validate!

        if seen_user_ids.include?(record.user_id)
          duplicate_index = index
          raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
        end

        seen_user_ids.add(record.user_id)
      end

      accesses = insert_records(records)
    rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
      record_not_unique = true
      raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
    end

    duplicate_index = find_duplicate_index(records) if record_not_unique

    if duplicate_index
      Result.new([], duplicate_index)
    else
      notify(accesses)
      Result.new(accesses, nil)
    end
  end

  private
    def build_records
      @grants.map do |grant|
        Access.new(book: @book, user_id: grant[:user_id], level: grant[:level])
      end
    end

    def preload_users(records)
      user_ids = records.filter_map(&:user_id).uniq
      users_by_id = user_ids.empty? ? {} : User.where(id: user_ids).index_by(&:id)

      records.each do |record|
        if (user = users_by_id[record.user_id])
          record.association(:user).target = user
        else
          record.association(:user).loaded!
        end
      end
    end

    def existing_user_ids_for(records)
      user_ids = records.filter_map(&:user_id).uniq
      return Set.new if user_ids.empty?

      @book.accesses.where(user_id: user_ids).pluck(:user_id).to_set
    end

    def insert_records(records)
      rows = records.map { |record| { user_id: record.user_id, level: record.level } }
      inserted = @book.accesses.insert_all!(rows, returning: Access.column_names)

      users_by_id = records.each_with_object({}) { |record, hash| hash[record.user_id] = record.user }
      accesses_by_user_id = inserted.each_with_object({}) do |row, hash|
        access = Access.instantiate(row)
        access.association(:book).target = @book
        access.association(:user).target = users_by_id[access.user_id]
        hash[access.user_id] = access
      end

      records.map { |record| accesses_by_user_id.fetch(record.user_id) }
    end

    def find_duplicate_index(records)
      seen_user_ids = existing_user_ids_for(records)

      records.each_with_index do |record, index|
        return index if seen_user_ids.include?(record.user_id)
        seen_user_ids.add(record.user_id)
      end

      nil
    end

    def notify(accesses)
      accesses.each do |access|
        Book::AccessNotificationJob.perform_later(access)
      end
    end
end
EOF

class Book::AccessImport
  Result = Struct.new(:accesses, :duplicate_index)

  def initialize(book, grants)
    @book, @grants = book, grants
  end

  def import
    records = build_records
    return Result.new([], nil) if records.empty?

    accesses = []
    duplicate_index = nil
    record_not_unique = false

    Access.transaction(requires_new: true) do
      preload_users(records)
      seen_user_ids = existing_user_ids_for(records)

      records.each_with_index do |record, index|
        record.validate!

        if seen_user_ids.include?(record.user_id)
          duplicate_index = index
          raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
        end

        seen_user_ids.add(record.user_id)
      end

      accesses = insert_records(records)
    rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
      record_not_unique = true
      raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
    end

    if record_not_unique
      duplicate_index = find_duplicate_index(records) or raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
    end

    if duplicate_index
      Result.new([], duplicate_index)
    else
      notify(accesses)
      Result.new(accesses, nil)
    end
  end

  private
    def build_records
      @grants.map do |grant|
        Access.new(book: @book, user_id: grant[:user_id], level: grant[:level])
      end
    end

    def preload_users(records)
      user_ids = records.filter_map(&:user_id).uniq
      users_by_id = user_ids.empty? ? {} : User.where(id: user_ids).index_by(&:id)

      records.each do |record|
        if (user = users_by_id[record.user_id])
          record.association(:user).target = user
        else
          record.association(:user).loaded!
        end
      end
    end

    def existing_user_ids_for(records)
      user_ids = records.filter_map(&:user_id).uniq
      return Set.new if user_ids.empty?

      @book.accesses.where(user_id: user_ids).pluck(:user_id).to_set
    end

    def insert_records(records)
      rows = records.map { |record| { user_id: record.user_id, level: record.level } }
      inserted = @book.accesses.insert_all!(rows, returning: Access.column_names)

      users_by_id = records.each_with_object({}) { |record, hash| hash[record.user_id] = record.user }
      accesses_by_user_id = inserted.each_with_object({}) do |row, hash|
        access = Access.instantiate(row)
        access.association(:book).target = @book
        access.association(:user).target = users_by_id[access.user_id]
        hash[access.user_id] = access
      end

      records.map { |record| accesses_by_user_id.fetch(record.user_id) }
    end

    def find_duplicate_index(records)
      seen_user_ids = existing_user_ids_for(records)

      records.each_with_index do |record, index|
        return index if seen_user_ids.include?(record.user_id)
        seen_user_ids.add(record.user_id)
      end

      nil
    end

    def notify(accesses)
      accesses.each do |access|
        Book::AccessNotificationJob.perform_later(access)
      end
    end
end

class Book::AccessImport
  Result = Struct.new(:accesses, :duplicate_index)

  def initialize(book, grants)
    @book, @grants = book, grants
  end

  def import
    records = build_records
    return Result.new([], nil) if records.empty?

    accesses = []
    duplicate_index = nil
    record_not_unique = false

    Access.transaction(requires_new: true) do
      preload_users(records)
      seen_user_ids = existing_user_ids_for(records)

      records.each_with_index do |record, index|
        record.validate!

        if seen_user_ids.include?(record.user_id)
          duplicate_index = index
          raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
        end

        seen_user_ids.add(record.user_id)
      end

      accesses = insert_records(records)
    rescue ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
      record_not_unique = true
      raise ActiveRecord::Rollback
    end

    if record_not_unique
      duplicate_index = find_duplicate_index(records) or raise ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
    end

    if duplicate_index
      Result.new([], duplicate_index)
    else
      notify(accesses)
      Result.new(accesses, nil)
    end
  end

  private
    def build_records
      @grants.each_with_object([]) do |grant, records|
        records << Access.new(book: @book, user_id: grant[:user_id], level: grant[:level])
      end
    end

    def preload_users(records)
      user_ids = records.filter_map(&:user_id).uniq
      users_by_id = user_ids.empty? ? {} : User.where(id: user_ids).index_by(&:id)

      records.each do |record|
        if (user = users_by_id[record.user_id])
          record.association(:user).target = user
        else
          record.association(:user).loaded!
        end
      end
    end

    def existing_user_ids_for(records)
      user_ids = records.filter_map(&:user_id).uniq
      return Set.new if user_ids.empty?

      @book.accesses.where(user_id: user_ids).pluck(:user_id).to_set
    end

    def insert_records(records)
      rows = records.map { |record| { user_id: record.user_id, level: record.level } }
      inserted = @book.accesses.insert_all!(rows, returning: Access.column_names)

      users_by_id = records.each_with_object({}) { |record, hash| hash[record.user_id] = record.user }
      accesses_by_user_id = inserted.each_with_object({}) do |row, hash|
        access = Access.instantiate(row)
        access.association(:book).target = @book
        access.association(:user).target = users_by_id[access.user_id]
        hash[access.user_id] = access
      end

      records.map { |record| accesses_by_user_id.fetch(record.user_id) }
    end

    def find_duplicate_index(records)
      seen_user_ids = existing_user_ids_for(records)

      records.each_with_index do |record, index|
        return index if seen_user_ids.include?(record.user_id)
        seen_user_ids.add(record.user_id)
      end

      nil
    end

    def notify(accesses)
      accesses.each do |access|
        Book::AccessNotificationJob.perform_later(access)
      end
    end
end
